title: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
reason: Original reporting tracing $6M in stolen funds from a $387.5M hack moving through THORChain despite blocking requests.

sources.summary: CoinDesk found 27 successful swaps moving about 2,390 ETH into 75.2 BTC, even as Bitget urged THORChain to stop serving addresses tied to the $387.5 million theft.
